title: Mochizuki Honami — Figuring Out What I Can Do〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Figuring Out What I Can Do（4★）

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Excuse me, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Welcome, Ms. Mochizuki.
It's nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's nice to see you too.
Shall I start cooking and cleaning as always?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Understood. I'll start with some cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
That was very good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And here's your after-dinner tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Oh, this is delicious. It has such a nice aroma too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Today, I made some chamomile tea to go with the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
To go with the flowers...?
Are these chamomiles?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, these are actually a type of chrysanthemum called “pom pom mums”.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They look quite different from regular chrysanthemums, but they're apparently in the same family.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I chose these from a list of flowers an old friend of mine gave me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, but here we are. The flowers on the packaging for this tea are chamomiles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, they look completely different. It's hard to believe that they're in the same family.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that's also what makes it so interesting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (When I first came here, I had such a hard time talking to her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I'm really glad that we've become so close like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your friend knows about so many interesting types of flowers. It's like this is a regular thing now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And didn't you say that you're in a band, Ms. Mochizuki? I hope this isn't taking too much time away from practice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Between practicing and writing lyrics, she's been very busy. However, she did say that it was a nice break for her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I promised myself that I wouldn't bring my personal problems into her house but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're just chatting and it came up during the course of our conversation, so it's okay, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We actually just performed at a live house the other day too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We even got a chance to play a song that we came up with instead of just covers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
An original song?
How does it go?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have some recordings from practice saved on my phone if you'd like to hear them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So this is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hm? This voice. Where have I heard this...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm getting so nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The songs that Ms. Yoisaki and her group make are all really amazing so...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can't help but wonder how our music sounds to her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Um... So, how was it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's easy to understand what sort of emotions it's trying to convey through its music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But that also takes away from what originality it could have. I think it needs a better hook.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to sound so snobbish...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you're an incredible composer so I'm happy to hear what you have to say about our song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad too then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
Does your vocalist ever do street performances by chance?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, I heard that she performs out in front of the station sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I could've sworn that I'd heard that voice before, but maybe my mind was just playing tricks on me...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you mind if I tell my bandmates about your thoughts regarding our song, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, sure. I don't see why not.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And one last thing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought that it was nice how your songwriter and lyricist both clearly thought about what they wanted the listener to feel as they heard this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The extent to which a song can reach into someone's heart can change greatly based on just that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Reach into someone's heart...
Oh, that's right...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's someone I'm trying to help.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I just don't know what to do sometimes. What would you do in a situation like that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would it be all right if I asked how that person you've been trying to help is doing now?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, well... In short, not much has changed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But this song I composed the other day did seem to resonate with them a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's when I made this realization.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's incredibly important to think about what you want your listener to feel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was so sure that Ms. Yoisaki never had any issues when it came to composing music...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But she goes through the same process of trial and error. She has to jump over the same hurdles as us...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Making music is so difficult...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And all I can do is watch my friends as they write songs and come up with lyrics for our band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I keep wishing that I could help in some way...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You believe in them.
Isn't that enough?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You placing your trust in them must be a significant part of why they can keep going.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even with me, your kindness is part of what keeps me afloat.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And I only see you once a week.
Imagine what your friends feel since you see them almost every day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
I didn't mean to bounce my personal problems off of you like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
This is nothing compared to how much you've already given me.
